CCS.FontSize.Name: Chat Card Font Size (px)
CCS.FontSize.Hint: Base font size for chat message content. Foundry's default is about 14.
CCS.ButtonSize.Name: Action Button Size (px)
CCS.ButtonSize.Hint: Width/height of the roll buttons (attack, damage, etc.) on chat cards.
CCS.IconSize.Name: Action Icon Size (px)
CCS.IconSize.Hint: Size of the icons inside those buttons.
CCS.Reset.Name: Reset to defaults
CCS.Reset.Hint: Tick and save to restore all three values to their defaults.
